nodes.name: 墨影
nodes.light: pale early-spring daylight coming straight through a small grilled window and through a sheet of paper held against it, against the cool grey dimness of a stone records room
nodes.camera: low behind the end of the clerks' table, past the keeper's shoulder, looking toward the bright window; a slight tilt
nodes.text: Scene: an early-spring morning in the clerks' room under the gate tower of a small fort set into a long white wall. The room is low and stone-walled, its far wall packed to the ceiling with shelves of old bound registers, and a single small window with an iron grille lets in pale daylight; through it, far off, an old elm beside a stone bridge holds a cluster of untidy stork nests. On the long table in the near foreground two rosters covered in rows of faded ink marks lie open side by side, weighted with an inkpot and a stone. At the window, in full profile facing right, stands the cherry-haired clerk: a round-faced, sturdy young woman of twenty-four in a grey wool coat with patched cuffs over a plain dress, her cherry-pink hair in one thick plait coiled at the back of her head with a charcoal pen stuck through it, a brass coachman's whistle on a cord at her neck. Her left hand holds one sheet up flat against the window so that the daylight shines through the thin paper; her lake-blue eyes are narrowed, her lips parted. Where one line of the sheet was scraped thin, fine threads of old ink are seeping back up out of the fibres and lifting a finger's width off the page as a faint dark shadow, and her right forefinger, ink under the nail, reaches into that floating shadow and passes through it. The marks are only strokes, nothing readable. At the table in the near left, partly cut off by the frame, sits the bone-white keeper of names, also in full profile facing right: a lean pale man who looks twenty-eight, pale ash-grey hair tied at the nape with a leather cord, a washed-out grey cloak, his knuckles and brow ridge faintly gleaming white, a small brass bell tied on his left wrist; his right hand holds a charcoal stick on the second roster, his left lies flat on the page with its crooked little finger showing, and he has looked up at her. Dust motes float large and out of focus in the window light across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕对名册那两拍（源稿第133、135行），吉塞拉迎着窗口的亮看出营里名册刮掉的一行，字行浮起来是她的段城对册法。奥迪莉亚那时在不在屋里源稿没写，画里没放她。

nodes.name: 日照门洞
nodes.light: bright morning sun pouring into the gate passage from behind us at the city end, warm white and gold on the stone, with the soft white glow of a single candle at the passage's centre and cool blue shade under the vault
nodes.camera: low inside the gate passage just behind the clerk's shoulder at the city end, looking straight down the passage and out over the bridge; a slight tilt
nodes.text: Scene: a clear spring morning inside the gate passage of a fort set into a long white wall; the gate stands wide open and the passage runs straight ahead of us, out onto a stone bridge over a dry moat. We stand at the city end, close behind the cherry-haired clerk, who is seen directly from behind: her cherry-pink plait coiled at the back of her head with a pen through it, a patched grey wool coat, a thick open register held up in her left hand, her right arm raised and a finger pointing along the line she has just read aloud. The morning sun comes in from behind us and floods the whole passage with white-gold light; the long shadow of the flagpole at our end lies across the floor, and at the far, outer end stands a second pole with a faded grey cloth flag marked with a pair of ox horns, its shadow also lying in the light. Exactly in the middle of the passage a single white candle burns in a crack between the floor stones, and beside it, facing us, stands the tall White Candle priestess: a thin, straight-backed woman of forty-five with pale gold hair pinned up and white at the temples, a narrow stern face, gold eyes, a grey-washed white robe with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, old wax scars on the backs of her hands; her right hand is held out flat, palm forward, her left hangs empty at her side. Passing each other right at the candle are two men: a gaunt human soldier in a faded patched tunic walking toward us, an iron cuff hanging sprung open from his wrist over a faintly glowing red brand; and a young demon-kin man with short bull horns and deep bronze-green skin walking away from us, seen from behind. On a stone step against the left wall sits the bone-white keeper of names in full profile, a notebook on his knee in his left hand, a charcoal stick in his right. Beyond the outer arch a line of ragged people waits on the bridge, and at its far end a huge horned figure has driven an iron staff upright into the ground beside him. Glowing dust drifts out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕日头照进门洞、白烛点着、头一对在烛边错开身子（源稿第142、143行）。头一对是铎尔坎的儿子图坎和营里放回来的鹳桥兵，兵腕上的铁扣是巴尔缇娜拨开的，这里画成已经弹开，巴尔缇娜没入画。桥那头插铁杖的是铎尔坎，太小，没进 who。

nodes.name: 一帘白光
nodes.light: warm amber candlelight spilling out of a tent doorway, orange torchlight on the backs of soldiers, against the cold blue of a spring night, with a faint pale-white glow hanging in the open doorway itself
nodes.camera: low behind the shoulders of the soldiers outside, a torch large and out of focus in the near corner, looking into the open tent; a slight tilt
nodes.text: Scene: a spring night beside the inner end of a fort's gate passage, where a large canvas tent has been pitched against the white wall as a field hospital. We stand outside in the dark among a handful of fort soldiers in old military greatcoats, seen from behind and cut off by the frame, one of them holding a burning torch close in the near right corner. Facing us in the tent doorway stands the tall White Candle priestess: a thin, straight-backed woman of forty-five, pale gold hair pinned up and white at the temples, a stern narrow face, gold eyes, a grey-washed white robe with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a white cord belt with a small leather pouch, a little bronze tag on a chain at her neck. With her left hand she holds the tent flap wide open and folded back; her right hand hangs open and empty at her side, the old wax scars on its back showing. She is not barring the way; she has opened it. Across the open doorway, from top to bottom, hangs a thin, still curtain of pale white light, faint as breath on cold glass. Deep inside the tent, low cots stand in rows under candles. On one cot sits a small pale demon-kin boy of five, wrapped in a grey blanket, his knuckles and brow faintly gleaming bone-white, a polished bone bell-clapper on a cord at his neck held in both his hands; he looks toward the doorway, very still. Beside him on a low stool, facing us, sits the red-haired demon-kin healer: a tall thin woman who looks thirty, dark red hair cut level at the ears, two small black-tipped curved horns, pale skin, dark red eyes glowing softly in the dark, a washed grey robe and a dark apron, a bone knife hanging on a cord at her neck, her long hands resting on her knees. Sparks from the torch drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕措尔家的兵夜里来医棚带孩子（源稿第155行），奥迪莉亚守着掀开的门帘，门口垂着的白光是她的敞门庇护，照锁写成看得见的样子。莫尔图斯五岁，画里没有伤。

nodes.name: 小篮子
nodes.light: late-summer afternoon sun slanting into the gate passage from the city end, warm on the new bronze, with the red glow of a basin of embers on the floor against the cool shade of the vault
nodes.camera: close and low beside the back of the stele, over the stonecutter's shoulder, on the chisel point; a slight tilt
nodes.text: Scene: a warm late-summer afternoon inside the gate passage of a fort set into a long white wall. At the city end of the passage, beside a tall flagpole, a new stele of dark mountain-copper bronze stands on a stone base, as tall as a man; its back faces us and is covered with neat rows of freshly carved marks in two columns, pair beside pair, nothing readable, only bright new grooves in the bronze. In the near foreground, large and partly cut off by the frame, kneels a stonecutter seen directly from behind: a lean young man in a grey cloak thrown back over his shoulders and a leather apron white with stone dust, his sleeves rolled. His left hand holds a fine chisel against the very bottom row of the stele and his right raises a small mallet; under the chisel point a tiny carved shape of a little woven basket has just been finished in the last square, opposite a single short line of marks. On the floor beside his knee stands a shallow iron basin heaped with glowing embers. A few steps back in the passage, in full profile facing the stele, stands the bone-white keeper of names: a lean pale man who looks twenty-eight, pale ash-grey hair tied at the nape, a washed-out grey cloak, a small brass bell on his left wrist, an open notebook in his right hand. Holding a fold of his left sleeve in one small fist stands a pale demon-kin boy of five in a plain grey tunic, also in full profile, a bone bell-clapper on a cord at his neck, his other hand at his side, his ice-blue eyes fixed on the little basket. Through the far, outer arch the stone bridge lies empty in the sun, and storks circle an old elm. Stone dust glitters out of focus in the sunbeams across the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束碑立在门洞靠城里一头，碑匠在背面最末一行刻小篮子（源稿第158、161行），那一盆炭是碑匠从雨城南门门洞引来的。哈诺和莫尔图斯站在碑边看刻是我推的，源稿只说他们后来回了雨城。

nodes.name: 栅后的灯
who: the copper-haired soldier with a plain old sword
the grey-haired girl from the rain city
nodes.light: the small warm light of a shuttered tin lantern behind iron bars and a thin line of blue light running up wet stone, against the cold blue-black of an autumn night under a faintly glowing white wall
nodes.camera: low at the foot of the sluice beside the soldier, looking up at the rusted grating and the vast stuck iron gate above; a slight tilt
nodes.text: Scene: an autumn night at the foot of a long white wall; the wall rises out of the top of the picture, its stone giving off a faint pale glow of its own. Set into its base is an abandoned sluice: an enormous single slab of cast iron, three storeys tall, hangs stuck halfway down in its slot, and beneath its lower edge, more than a man's height above the ground, a rusted red-brown iron grating closes the dark mouth of the sluice. The huge gate has just ground a little way downward and stopped again. On the left, in full profile facing right toward the grating, stands the copper-haired soldier with a plain old sword: a tall young woman of twenty, old-copper gold-brown hair hacked off at the shoulder and tied back with a length of hemp rope, the fringe untidy, pale gold eyes, a patched old leather cuirass over a washed-out grey coat; her right hand rests on the hemp-wrapped grip of the plain sword at her hip, her left hangs at her side, and her face is level and watchful. Behind the bars, facing us, stands the ink-haired sluice-keeper's daughter: a small wiry young woman with ink-blue hair cut at the earlobes, a pale face, pale silver eyes, a short oilcloth coat, her mouth open on a sharp warning; her right hand holds up a small shuttered tin lantern, and her left wrist is pressed flat against the stone of the sluice wall, where a thin line of blue light runs up from her wrist along the stones all the way to the top of the iron gate. Leaning half out from behind the end of the grating, facing us, is the grey-haired girl from the rain city: small and slight, looking sixteen or seventeen, ash-silver hair in one braid hanging to her waist, cold pale skin, faintly pointed ears, a small red mark at one temple, a plain grey cloak frayed at the cuffs, a leather-bound notebook at her belt; her left hand holds a bar, her right rests on the notebook, and in the dark her eyes glow a soft molten copper-gold, turned on the soldier. Drops falling from the iron gate glint large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕夜里铁栅前头一回见面（源稿第452、453行），赫尔佳的蓝纹止住往下沉的闸。607年巴尔缇娜没扮精灵，用 casual 那一格，夜里眼睛亮成熔开的山铜色照她的旅伴条外貌写。

nodes.name: 半截号声
nodes.light: flat white autumn noon light from above with a sudden flash of pale blue-white from the split horn, against the dull red glow of brands on the necks below and the grey shade of the wall
nodes.camera: low among the front row of the branded vanguard, just behind the giant smith's shoulder, looking up the stone steps of the sluice platform at the blow; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: autumn noon at an abandoned sluice at the foot of a long white wall, the vast stuck iron gate and its rusted grating behind. A stone platform with a short flight of steps rises above the sluice mouth. On it, facing us, stands the old bugler: a thin stooped man of sixty-two in a thick grey fort coat buttoned to the chin, thin white hair in one thin plait, his cheeks puffed round; he has just raised a long cow-horn bugle with a copper mouthpiece to his lips with both hands. At this instant the horn has been cut clean through in the middle: the front half is dropping out of his left hand, while his right hand still clutches the mouthpiece half at his lips, and a ring of old carved marks just below the mouthpiece flares once in a pale blue-white flash. The stroke came from the copper-haired soldier, who has just stepped up onto the platform on the left and stands in full profile at the end of her downward swing: a tall young woman of twenty, old-copper gold-brown hair tied back with hemp rope, pale gold eyes, a patched leather cuirass over a grey coat; both hands grip a plain straight old sword brought down low, and the hemp wound round its grip has scorched black for a hand's width, a thread of smoke rising from it. On a horse at the right edge of the platform sits a man in a fine coat, staring. Below the platform, in the near foreground, the branded vanguard stand in three ragged rows, seen from behind: men and women in grey smocks, on the back of every neck a brand glowing dull red, some of them dropped to their knees. Right in front, large and cut off by the frame, stands the giant horned smith, seen directly from behind: two heads taller than the rest, deep bronze skin, ox horns curving outward, three turns of iron chain round his waist glowing hot blue, both huge scarred hands pressed flat on the chains. Grit and pale blue sparks fly out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕里德劈号角那一下（源稿第461行），号角从当中劈开，洛伦茨一只手攥着带号嘴的那一半没撒手（照洛伦茨人物条）。马上的是段守恩格尔贝特。烙印发烫不算伤，raw 没开。

nodes.name: 黑莓酱
who: the grey-haired girl from the rain city
nodes.light: warm orange firelight glowing out of a city gate passage up the slope, against the soft blue-grey of a misty dusk after drizzle
nodes.camera: level and close on the wet slope just below the two young women, the jam bread large in the frame, looking slightly up past them at the city gate; a slight tilt
nodes.text: Scene: late autumn dusk on a grassy slope outside the south gate of a grey walled city built against the foot of a long white wall. A fine grey drizzle has just stopped; the grass is wet and the air holds a thin mist. Up the slope, the city gate's dark arch glows with the orange light of a fire burning inside the passage, and beside that fire, small and far, a tall figure in a long pale coat sits, seen from behind. Up the muddy road toward the gate walk a giant horned smith with chains round his waist and a boy of ten at his side, both seen from behind, followed by a straggling line of ragged families. In the near foreground, close to us, two young women stand facing each other in full profile. On the right is the grey-haired girl from the rain city: small and slight, looking sixteen or seventeen, ash-silver hair in one long braid down her back, cold pale skin, faintly pointed ears, a small red mark at one temple, a plain grey cloak frayed at the cuffs over a dark dress, a leather-bound notebook at her belt; her right hand holds out a round loaf spread with a thick, glistening layer of dark purple blackberry jam, thicker than the bread itself, and her left hand holds a second loaf against her chest; her face is calm and serious, one corner of her mouth just turning up. On the left is the copper-haired soldier: a tall young woman of twenty, old-copper gold-brown hair tied back with hemp rope, the fringe untidy, pale gold eyes, a patched leather cuirass under a washed-out grey coat, a hemp-wrapped plain sword at her hip and a cloth bag at the small of her back; her left hand has taken the jam bread and she has just bitten into it, a smear of jam at the corner of her mouth, her eyes creasing into a grin, her right thumb hooked in her belt. Mist and tiny raindrops drift out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕霜降月中旬到雨城那天傍晚，南门外坡上的第三顿饭（源稿第479行），里德就是这一口以后报的名字。门洞火边的高个子是那个不说名字的女人，只写远远的背影。往坡上走的是博鲁和十岁的格罗姆。

nodes.name: 碑脚
nodes.light: bright early-summer midday sun, warm on the new bronze and on the white wall, against the cool blue shade under the stuck iron gate
nodes.camera: at ground level beside the foot of the new stele, looking up along it toward the white wall; a slight tilt
nodes.text: Scene: a bright early-summer midday at an abandoned sluice at the foot of a long white wall. On the old stone platform beside the sluice mouth stands a new stele of dark mountain-copper bronze, taller than a man, its face carved with neat marks, nothing readable; a stonecutter in a dusty leather apron stands on a short ladder at its side with a chisel. Behind it the vast cast-iron sluice gate still hangs stuck halfway in the wall above its rusted grating. In the near foreground, at the foot of the stele, two men kneel on the stone with the two halves of a broken cow-horn bugle. On the left, in full profile facing right, kneels the old bugler: a thin stooped man of sixty-five in a clean dark grey fort coat, bareheaded, thin white hair in one thin plait, a ring of calluses round his lips; with both hands he holds the front half of the horn flat against the stone base. On the right, facing us, kneels the giant horned smith: a huge demon-kin man, two heads taller than other men even kneeling, deep bronze skin like heated iron, ox horns curving outward with the tip of one chipped, very pale grey eyes lowered, cropped dull copper-brown hair, a sleeveless linen shirt and a scorched leather apron, three turns of iron chain at his waist; his huge scarred left hand holds a hand-forged iron nail to the other half of the horn and his right hand raises a small hammer. The two halves lie one on each side of the base, their open ends pointing toward the sluice. Behind them, in a loose row along the sluice mouth, nineteen plain people in worn clothes stand watching in silence; at the end of the row, in full profile, stands the white-gold-haired gate guard, a sturdy young man with very short white-gold hair, wind-red cheeks, amber eyes, old leather armour with a worn bright left shoulder plate, a short spear held upright in his right hand. Swallows and drifting seed fluff pass out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束610年蝉鸣月闸口立碑，洛伦茨和博鲁拿博鲁打的钉子把两半号角钉在碑脚，一边一半，号嘴朝着闸（源稿第488行）。马克斯跟留下的十九个人一起守着碑匠刻完（照他的旅伴条）。

nodes.name: 第四份
nodes.light: harsh early-summer noon sun overhead glittering on blood-red water, against the hard cool shadow thrown by the towering dock walls
nodes.camera: low on the slanting surface of the sunken tower's crown beside the shaft mouth, looking across the red pool toward the dock mouth; tilted
nodes.text: Scene: noon in early summer at an old stone dock on a great river. The dock basin is a vast square pool walled with huge blocks several times a man's height, and its water is dark blood-red, glittering everywhere with tiny shards of crystal. Rising out of that red water at a steep slant is the crown of a sunken floating tower, a massive dome of rust-dark iron and bronze bigger than a mansion roof, pocked with black holes where scavengers have pried away its fittings; we stand low on its slanting surface, beside the black round mouth of a shaft that runs down into the tower. A rope runs taut from the top of the dock wall high above down to an iron ring at the shaft's lip. In the near foreground, in full profile, kneels the tangerine-haired rope-man: a thick-shouldered man of twenty-eight with uncut tangerine-orange hair over his ears, cobalt eyes shadowed underneath, a leather vest over an old canvas coat with a crookedly stitched badge of a bell and seven lines on the chest; both rope-callused hands are knotting the rope's end to the ring, and a brass bell hangs at the end of the coil on his belt. Behind him, facing us, stands the copper-haired mercenary: a tall woman of twenty-eight, old-copper gold-brown hair tied back with hemp rope, pale gold eyes, a patched leather cuirass under a grey coat, a hemp-wrapped plain sword slung on her back; her right hand tucks a quarter loaf of bread into the cloth bag at the small of her back and her left holds the other three pieces. At the shaft's edge, in full profile, looking down into the dark, stands the hooded elf mage: small and slight, a grey-green hooded long cloak with the hood up, a lock of grey hair across the brow, a plain uncarved white wooden staff upright in her right hand, her left hand holding her cloak closed. Far off at the dock mouth, red water seeps through a crack in the old timber sluice gate beside a keeper's hut, and at the gate's foot crouches a tiny silver-haired figure with a tall staff, studying the gate. Red spray and glittering crystal flecks catch the light out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕幕终下坞以前（源稿第740行），里德把三个人的面包分成四份，多的那一份留给上来的人，巴斯蒂安把绳头拴在塔冠上。灰叶是扮成精灵的巴尔缇娜，用 battle 那一格（灰绿兜帽长斗篷、白木杖）。远处闸门边蹲着的是芙莉莲，太小，没进 who。监炉尤利乌斯这时也在塔冠上，画里没放他。

nodes.name: 炉钩
nodes.light: the last dull red glow dying in the furnace on the giant armour's back and a small lantern's warmth on the floor, against deep cold blue-black darkness, with one faint gold glint under a hood
nodes.camera: low behind the kneeling armour's shoulder, its raised hook arching over the top of the frame, looking at the soldier and the hooded mage beyond; tilted
nodes.text: Scene: before dawn, deep inside a sunken floating tower, in a hall as wide as a town square, where rows of iron hooks hang from the dark ceiling and eleven white-painted lines run across the stone floor. Everywhere along the lines kneel hollow suits of Western plate armour, more than a hundred of them, the little furnaces on their backs gone dark, their empty visors black. In the near foreground, large and cut off by the left edge of the frame, kneels the biggest armour of all, seen from behind: a full suit of dark iron plate a head taller than the rest, with a bigger furnace on its back whose last red glow is dying out right now. It has just gone down on one knee, but its long iron furnace-hook, a straight heavy pole longer than a man with a short square-cut hook at the end, is still raised high in its right gauntlet and hangs over the top of the frame, its tip stopped in the air right above the soldier's head. Facing us beyond it, before the open door of a small watch-room, with a lantern on the floor beside her, stands the copper-haired mercenary: a tall woman of twenty-eight, old-copper gold-brown hair tied back with hemp rope and coming loose, pale gold eyes, a patched leather cuirass torn at one shoulder, her grey coat ripped; she has held this doorway all night. A cut at the outer end of her left eyebrow, on the viewer's right, is bleeding, and the blood has run down into that eye, which she keeps open; sweat and grime streak her face. Both hands grip a plain straight old sword with a hemp-wrapped grip, raised level in front of her, its blade unchipped. A step to her right, also facing us, stands the hooded elf mage, small and slight, the grey-green hood up and a lock of grey hair across the brow; she holds an open leather notebook in both hands with a white staff tucked under her left arm, her lips just parting on the last name, and in the shadow of her hood her eyes give one faint gold glint. Drifting soot and cooling red sparks hang out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕天亮灰叶念到最后一个名字，炉师那一副甲跪下、炉钩还举着（源稿第763、764行）。里德左眉尾叫炉钩挑开的口子在流血，raw 开了。炉钩写成直杆方钩，避开弯月的样子。兜帽底下闪一下金，照案子银叶里巴斯蒂安看见的那一下。

nodes.name: 倚剑
nodes.light: warm slanting gold of a summer afternoon from the left and bright glare off white stone, against the cool blue shade under the colonnade at the top of the steps
nodes.camera: low on the steps beside the stuck sword, looking up past the woman toward the hall doors far above; a slight tilt
nodes.text: Scene: a long summer afternoon at the palace of a great river city. A broad flight of white stone steps climbs from the bottom of the picture toward a colonnaded palace hall at the very top, its tall doors shut, two guards in polished half-armour and white surcoats standing motionless in the shade before them, banners with a golden kite hanging still. Partway up the steps an old long sword is driven upright into one of the stone treads, so deep that only the upper part of its blade, its plain cross-guard and its grip stand out of the stone; it looks plain, pale and very old. Leaning against it with her back and one shoulder, in full profile facing right, stands the copper-haired mercenary: a tall woman of twenty-eight, old-copper gold-brown hair hacked off at the shoulder and tied back with hemp rope, the fringe untidy, pale gold eyes, a thin fresh scab at the outer end of her left eyebrow on the side toward us, a patched leather cuirass under a washed-out grey coat, her own hemp-wrapped plain sword at her hip, a cloth bag at the small of her back. Both arms are folded across her chest, one ankle crossed over the other; her head is tipped back against the old sword's cross-guard, her eyes half-closed against the light, with the patient face of someone who has already waited a long time and will keep waiting. Her shadow lies long down the steps. To one side of the steps, high up, a small door in the hall's flank stands ajar. A few pigeons strut on the upper steps. Warm dust floats out of focus in the slanting light across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕殿上只让法师进去，里德靠着石阶前一柄剑等了一下午（源稿第777行）。那一柄是破晓，照锁只写一柄插在石阶里的旧剑，不画它偏的那一下。左眉尾结着痂，raw 开了。

nodes.name: 最末一行
nodes.light: soft overcast autumn light from a pale sky, the river beyond clear grey-green, against the dark red of the dock pool still shut behind the gate
nodes.camera: low among the weapons planted at the dock mouth, looking past a spear shaft at the stele and the man beside it; a slight tilt
nodes.text: Scene: an overcast autumn day at the mouth of an old stone dock on a great river; the river beyond is clear again and grey-green, but behind the old timber sluice gate the dock pool is still dark red. A new stele of dark mountain-copper bronze stands at the dock mouth, a little taller than a man, its back toward us covered with columns of carved marks, nothing readable. All around its foot stand weapons planted upright in the earth, the arms of the men who went down and did not come up: spears, a pair of short swords, a broad hammer, an axe, bent and rusted, with gaps in the rows where others were never found. A spear shaft rises out of focus in the near foreground. Beside the stele, facing us, stands the tangerine-haired rope-man: a thick-shouldered man of twenty-eight, uncut tangerine-orange hair, cobalt eyes with dark shadows beneath, his old canvas coat brushed clean, a leather vest, a crookedly stitched badge of a bell with seven lines on his chest; his right hand rests on the stele's edge and his left holds the coil of hemp rope with its brass bell at his belt; he has just finished speaking, his face tired and steady. At the stele's foot a stonecutter kneels with his back to us, setting his chisel to the very last line. To the left, in the doorway of a small keeper's hut, stands the old dock-keeper in full profile: a tall, thin, stooped man of seventy-one, thin white hair, clean-shaven, pale blue eyes, an oilcloth coat with patched cuffs, a ring of keys at his belt, an oilcloth-wrapped register held to his chest in both arms. Far to the right, at the foot of the old sluice gate, unnoticed by anyone, crouches the small silver-haired elf in full profile: a slight girl who looks sixteen, long silver-white hair parted in the middle and tied in two tails, long pointed ears, red drop earrings, a silver-grey travelling cloak, her tall staff laid beside her, her right forefinger tracing a small charm carved into the gate planks, her left hand on her knee. Fallen yellow leaves blow out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束坠叶月坞口立碑，巴斯蒂安报完二十一个名字说把他刻在后头，背面最末一行是他（源稿第799到801行）。赫伯特说名字在坞簿上不上石头，芙莉莲蹲在旧闸门边上没有人想起她。

nodes.name: 虎口
who: the freckled girl with the honey braid
nodes.light: a hand lamp's warm light on the passage walls, a raised lamp and a tiny candle flame beyond the opening, copper veins in the fallen stone catching the glow, against the cold dark of an early-spring night
nodes.camera: from inside the stone passage, low, looking out through the opening at the night; a slight tilt
nodes.text: Scene: a cold early-spring night at the mouth of a mountain behind a village chapel. We are inside the mountain, low in a narrow stone passage that slopes down behind us into darkness, looking back out through its opening at the night. The passage walls close to us are covered with scratches made by fingernails and pebbles, rows of tally lines and crude marks, nothing readable. Just outside the ragged opening, leaning on its side against the rock, lies the door-sized slab of stone that sealed it, its edges veined with dull copper that catches the light. Stepping into the passage toward us, facing us, comes the raven-haired swordswoman: a short woman of twenty-three with very thick back and shoulders, glossy raven-black hair with a blue sheen tied loosely at the neck with a leather cord, a square face with heavy brows, violet eyes looking straight ahead into the dark; worn old leather armour with mended sleeves, a coil of rope and a small knife at her belt, a plain narrow iron sword strapped on her back, and no banner of any kind. Her right hand holds up a small lamp. Her left hand hangs at her side: the web between its thumb and forefinger is split open from prying the stone loose, and blood runs down her fingers and drips onto the floor of the passage. Outside, behind her on the left, the old stone-sealer stands facing us: a tall, stooped, white-bearded man in a scorched leather apron, chisels at his belt, holding a lamp high above his head in his right hand, his left hand at his side with its half little finger showing. To the right of the opening, in full profile, crouches the freckled girl with the honey braid, about fifteen, in a long coarse wool dress and apron, red thread at the end of her braid; both her hands are cupped round a candle stub she has just lit on a rock at the very edge of the opening, its tiny flame steady. Cold mist and a few sparks from the lamps drift out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕上旬十日夜里徒手掰开去年的封石进山（源稿第1052、1053行），镜头在山道里往外看。薇丝塔用 formal 那一格（皮甲、身上没背旗），637年还没有白鸦旗。汉娜十五岁，只是点着蜡烛头，没受伤，raw 是薇丝塔虎口的血。

nodes.name: 拔牙
nodes.light: a pale ivory glow from the coiled roots and the great bone and teal reflections off churning spring water, with the small orange light of a lamp on a rock, against the black of wet cave stone
nodes.camera: low at the surface of the warm pool, water at the lens, looking up at the woman and the bone tearing loose; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: deep inside a mountain, in a cavern larger than a chapel hall, wet dark stone streaming with water on every side. Its floor is a pool of warm spring water now churning waist-deep, and around its middle the ground is bleached dead white. Filling the upper left of the picture, cut off by the frame, is a vast coiled mass of pale ivory roots like a tree that grew upside down, thicker than chapel pillars: nine of its great roots have been hacked through and their stumps gush warm milky-white sap that turns the stone white where it splashes, and torrents of clear spring water burst from the cuts. The last two roots coil tight around a huge yellowish-white bone, bigger than a millstone, half sunk in the white ground. In the centre, in full profile facing left, stands the raven-haired swordswoman: a short woman of twenty-three with very thick shoulders, glossy raven-black hair with a blue sheen come loose from its leather cord, heavy brows drawn together, violet eyes fixed on the bone, teeth gritted; worn leather armour soaked and spattered white with sap, small cuts on her forearms, the split web of her left hand bleeding again. Her narrow iron sword, snapped off at half its length, is thrust through her belt. Her right foot is planted on the bone where it bears its weight; both hands grip the last two roots like ropes over her right shoulder, and her whole body leans back, hauling, as the bone tears up out of the white ground like a tooth coming out of a jaw, clods of white earth and white sap flying. A small lamp burns on a rock at the water's edge. Spray, drops of sap and flecks of white earth fly large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕砍到第九条根剑断了半截，她一脚踩住骨头，两只手攥住剩下两条根，连骨头拔出来（源稿第1064行）。beast 用 bronze_002_2（白地之牙），它说话那一层不入画。

nodes.name: 围门之夜
who: the freckled girl with the honey braid
nodes.light: orange torchlight from the crowd in the near foreground, against the hot dry blue-black of a cloudless midsummer night
nodes.camera: low among the backs of the torch-bearers, looking past torches being lowered at the people before the stone; a slight tilt
nodes.text: Scene: a hot midsummer night in a drought-struck mountain valley. In the background, terraced fields climb the dark hillside cracked and bare, the wheat standing dead and yellow, and above them the mountain peak stands clear against the stars with no cloud on it at all. At the edge of the village stands a small empty stone house, and outside its door lies a flat stone with a lidded clay bowl on it. We are among a crowd of villagers in the near foreground, seen from behind and cut off by the frame, holding up torches; some of the torches are already sinking, their flames dipping toward the dust. On the flat stone, facing us, sits the raven-haired swordswoman: a short, very thick-shouldered woman of twenty-three, glossy raven-black hair tied loosely at the neck, heavy brows, violet eyes, worn leather armour with mended sleeves, a healing scar across the web of her left hand; a narrow sword broken off at half its length lies across her knees under both her hands, and she does not move. Directly in front of her stands a broad, quiet quarryman in a dusty smock, facing the crowd and us, his arms at his sides; and in front of him, facing us, stands the freckled girl with the honey braid: a slight girl of sixteen with olive-green eyes and a face full of freckles, a long coarse wool dress and apron, her chin up, her hands clenched at her sides, unafraid. On the left the old stone-sealer, a tall, stooped, white-bearded man in a scorched leather apron, has just sat down heavily on the end of the flat stone beside the swordswoman, facing us, his left hand on his knee, his right fist at his mouth as he coughs. At the far right edge of the crowd an old woman in a long black robe stands with a wooden staff, half in shadow, silent. Embers from the torches drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕蝉鸣月火把围门那一夜（源稿第1071行），博多站到她前头，汉娜站到她父亲前头，戈特哈德坐到石头上咳了一声，火把一支一支放下来。汉娜十六岁，没受伤。人群边上的老妇人是守堂的蕾吉娜。

nodes.name: 新刃
who: the freckled girl with the honey braid
nodes.light: soft warm spring morning sun after rain from the upper right, on wet green terraces, against the cool shade of the stone house
nodes.camera: low beside the flat stone, close on the new blade, looking up at the swordswoman and the old man; a slight tilt
nodes.text: Scene: a fresh spring morning after rain in a green mountain valley. The terraced fields are wet and newly green, a spring runs bright down the hillside, and the mountain peak above stands clear in a blue sky. Up the slope beside the chapel, a low stack of broken copper-veined slabs of stone lies piled on the bare ground. In the near foreground is a flat stone outside a small stone house, a lidded clay bowl with a chipped rim set on it, and on the stone sits the raven-haired swordswoman, facing us: a short, very thick-shouldered woman of twenty-seven, glossy raven-black hair with a blue sheen tied loosely at the neck, a square face with heavy brows, violet eyes, worn leather armour with mended sleeves, an old scar across the web of her left hand. Her right hand holds a newly forged narrow sword out at arm's length, testing its balance: the blade is new, with a faint warm copper sheen along its length, but the plain guard and the worn grip are old. Her left hand rests on her knee. Her face shows nothing, but she cannot take her eyes off the blade. Standing before her in full profile, having just handed the sword over, is the old stone-sealer: a tall, stooped man of sixty-seven with short white hair and a short white beard, stone dust on his ears, big thick hands with the left little finger half missing, a scorched leather apron, a strip of linen wound round his right wrist; his hands hang empty at his sides. Behind him on the field path, facing us, stands the freckled girl with the honey braid, now about nineteen, the braid tied with red thread, a leather apron over her wool dress, a small hammer at her belt, her hands clasped at her apron, smiling. Raindrops glitter on the grass out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束萌芽月下旬戈特哈德把重锻的剑拿到石头上给她（源稿第1082、1084行），剑身是熔了带铜的封石锻的，写成淡淡的铜色，护手和柄是原来的。兽耳猎人是这以后几天才到村口的，所以没画进来。

nodes.name: 歪翅
nodes.light: warm high spring sunlight over yellow southern hills from above and behind, against soft green shade under a lone tree
nodes.camera: low beside the roadside rock, close on the canvas in her lap, looking up at the two of them; a slight tilt
nodes.text: Scene: a warm spring day on a mountain road through yellow southern hills, the valleys below green, a small merchant caravan of mules and a cart resting on the road behind. By the roadside, under a lone twisted tree, the raven-haired swordswoman sits on a rock facing us: a short, very thick-shouldered woman of twenty-seven, glossy raven-black hair with a blue sheen tied loosely at the neck with a leather cord, heavy brows drawn together in concentration, violet eyes on her work, worn leather armour with mended sleeves, a new narrow sword with a faint copper sheen leaning against the rock. Across her knees lies a piece of old grey canvas, and with a big needle and thick white thread she is stitching a white bird onto it: the bird is clumsy and lopsided, one wing sewn badly crooked, hardly recognisable as a raven. Her left hand holds the canvas taut, her right pulls the needle through. Standing beside her in full profile, looking down at the canvas, is the beast-eared archer: a tall, thin young man of twenty-two, shoulder blades showing through his old grey-brown coat with its collar turned up, short ash-brown hair, a pair of grey-brown animal ears on top of his head, both of them whole and unhurt, no human ears; light amber eyes. His short bow of old worn wood hangs in his left hand, and he has just burst out laughing, his right hand half raised. Down the slope behind them a pack horse with a muddy flank grazes, safe again on the road, its load still strapped on. Spring pollen and small white petals from the tree drift out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕花信月往南段的山路上歇脚缝旗（源稿第1312行），鸦缝歪了，卡尔恩笑。他的左耳644年冬天才冻掉一块，这一幅两只耳朵都是好的，跟立绘不一样，提示词里写明了。薇丝塔用 formal 那一格，旗这时候还在她膝上。

nodes.name: 后颈一箭
nodes.light: grey-violet winter dusk light and cold snow glare from the open sky, with one small amber lantern on a lone cart far below, against blue-grey snow shadow
nodes.camera: from directly behind the archer in his snow hollow on the near ridge, the drawn bow large in the foreground, looking across the gulf at the white stag on the far slope; tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dusk in deep winter high on a mountain pass on the snow line. The snow has stopped for a moment. We are directly behind the beast-eared archer, who lies braced in a hollow dug into the snow behind a rock on a ridge, seen directly from behind and large in the foreground: a tall, thin young man in an old grey-brown coat with the collar up, snow on his shoulders, short ash-brown hair, a pair of grey-brown animal ears on top of his head, both still whole; his left arm holds a short bow of old worn wood out at full stretch and his right hand has just released the string, which is still quivering by his cheek. Across a deep gulf of air, on the crest of the opposite snow slope, stands an enormous white stag, taller than a merchant wagon, its back to us: its antlers spread wider than a wagon and hang with icicles, the white fur of its back is crusted with rime like frost. It stands still, its head lowered toward the pass far below. The arrow has just struck: a single dark arrow stands buried in the back of its neck. Below, at the bottom of the pass between the two slopes, a small empty cart stands with a crude white-bird banner on a pole and a lantern hanging from it; its horse, cut loose, is bolting away with a stubby figure running after it through the snow. Under the stag's feet the snow of the whole slope has begun to crack and slide, a white wall starting to move. Far down the valley the warm light of a long hall's door glows, a slender figure standing in it. Fine snow and ice crystals blow out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕归寂月下旬黄昏，白母站在坡顶脸朝着车、背朝着山脊，卡尔恩一箭从后颈射进去（源稿第1327、1328行），镜头在他背后。坡下砍了套绳跟着马跑的是薇丝塔，长厅门口站着的是莉赛尔，都太小，没进 who。

nodes.name: 赤尘之浪
nodes.light: harsh white autumn sun high over red salt flats, the air thick with glowing crimson dust, against the grey-brown shadow of the massed beasts
nodes.camera: at ground level on the salt crust directly in his path, looking up at the rider coming straight at us, beasts parting on both sides; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: an autumn day on the red salt flats along the north shore of an inland sea; the crust underfoot is cracked salt full of red crystal, and the sea glints flat and pale far to one side. A dense tide of beasts from the edge of the dead lands fills the plain to the horizon, a heaving dark mass of grey and rust-coloured hides: hyena-like scavengers the size of wolves and of oxen, horns, armoured backs, many legs. Straight through the middle of it, coming directly at us, gallops the long-legged half-orc lancer on a lathered dark horse: a very tall, lean young man with absurdly long legs, grey-brown skin, a face with no expression at all, two short lower tusks just showing over his upper lip, ash-blond hair shaved very short with one thin short plait at the back whipping behind him, pale amber eyes fixed ahead; a short much-worn leather jerkin and an open iron cap. A very long lance is couched under his right arm and gripped in his right hand, level, its point aimed straight at us; his left hand holds the reins low. Where he passes, the beasts are flung aside to both sides and fall, dark blood splashed across the salt, and behind him the red salt crust has been torn up into a great rolling wave of crimson dust that curls back over the beasts like a breaking sea. The lane he has torn runs back to the horizon behind him, and along it, far and small, a column of riders and footsoldiers under banners follows through the open way. His jerkin is spattered with dark blood and a shallow scratch runs across his left forearm. Red dust and salt crystals blast out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕援军要绕，托伦一个人从潮的后队正中撞过去，盐壳腾成赤红的尘浪（源稿第1346行）。魔物潮源稿没写是什么，照补卷_16 死域边上的骸鬣写成成群的兽，没起名。他的岁数源稿两处对不上，text 里没写岁数。

nodes.name: 门后的人
who: the stocky dwarf with the heavy sword
nodes.light: dying molten orange from the cracks of a fallen slag-crusted beast and a lantern's warm yellow behind, with the last cold blue-green flickers of falling rune fragments, against the black of a deep stone hall
nodes.camera: low inside the stone hall beside a waking dwarf against the wall, looking out through the smashed doorway at the swordsman; a slight tilt
nodes.text: Scene: the deepest level of an old dwarven mine under a cliff, where a great stone gate and the whole carved wall around it have just been smashed into rubble. We are inside, in a long, deep stone hall behind the broken gate, low by its side wall. In the near foreground, large and partly cut off by the frame, sits a young dwarf man against the wall in full profile, dust on his braided beard and his clothes, a mining lamp and tools neatly beside him; he has just opened his eyes and is lifting his head as if from sleep. Further along the wall others sit in a row, grey with dust, a few of them stirring, and beyond them only empty armour and tools laid out in tidy rows. In the broken doorway, facing us, stands the stocky dwarf with the heavy sword: a short, very broad dwarf who looks like a man in his late twenties, rust-brown hair cut short, a very short trimmed rust-brown beard, heavy straight brows over grey-blue eyes, an old leather jerkin with iron plates riveted on the shoulders. He holds a thick, straight dwarven heavy sword lowered in both huge hands, its point resting on the rubble; his knuckles are split and bleeding, his chest heaves, dust and grit cover him. Across the threshold at his feet lies a huge crawling beast with a crust of black slag, a ridge of hardened lava along its back and dozens of short legs, its wedge-shaped head crushed; the molten orange glow in the cracks of its shell is fading out. All around, fragments of carved stone are still falling, the glowing marks on them flickering blue-green and going dark one by one. Behind him in the passage an old dwarf woman holds up a lantern, her other hand at her mouth. Falling grit and the last dying sparks drift out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束655年铁瀑，第二百三十七下砸在门后那东西头上，它倒在门槛上，门后石厅里前几十年进去的人醒过来（源稿第1354行，遗迹铁瀑封印门第3352、3353行）。beast 用 bronze_005_1，就是熔脊。举灯的是来找儿子的断崖老妇人，近处醒过来的是她儿子。

nodes.name: 手套
who: the silver-haired daughter in red gloves
the grey-haired girl at the head of the table
nodes.light: warm lamplight from above along the long table, against the grey wet daylight of rain at the open shutters behind
nodes.camera: low at the table's edge over the shoulder of the man with the ledger, looking across the table at the standing young woman; a slight tilt
nodes.text: Scene: a rainy spring day inside a long, low rope-maker's hall in a grey walled city. One very long table runs from the door to the far wall, pieced together plank by plank, pale oak on the near side and dark pine on the far side, the seams between them left rough; long benches line both sides, crowded with delegates, humans on the near side and demon-kin of many kinds on the far side, lamps hanging overhead, rain streaming past the open shutters. In the near foreground, out of focus and cut off by the frame, a round-shouldered man in a dark green coat sits with his back to us, one finger stopped on a column of figures in a thick brass-cornered ledger. Across the table, facing us, sits the silver-haired envoy: a tall thin demon-kin man who looks thirty-five, silver-white hair brushed back with a grey streak at each temple, deep crimson eyes lowered to the table, a deep red high-collared coat and a short black cloak; both his hands, in worn dark red gloves, lie flat on the planks, and he does not turn round. Directly behind him, facing us, stands the silver-haired daughter in red gloves: a tall, graceful young demon-kin woman of twenty-five, long silver-white hair to her waist with one thin braid through it, short pointed ears, pale skin, deep crimson eyes narrowed and fixed on the man with the ledger, a long deep red dress buttoned high at the throat and a short black cloak; she has just risen from the bench behind her father, and her left hand is tugging the cuff of the thin dark red glove back onto her right hand. Her lips are parted on a question. Every face along the table has turned to her and nobody speaks. At the far end, small, the grey-haired girl at the head of the table sits upright in full profile in a dark high-collared dress, an open notebook in her left hand and her pen stopped in her right. Lamp haze and rain blur out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕第四天莉西娅从她父亲身后站起来，摘了手套又戴回去，问她十一岁那年值几袋（源稿第1644行）。近处背对着的是海因茨·魏岑，没进 who。

nodes.name: 翼尖黑丝
nodes.light: pale grey-gold first light low over the river ahead of him, with the warm spark of a lamp in the reeds behind, against the cool blue-grey of river mist
nodes.camera: just above the water surface, low ahead of the flier, looking back toward the far bank as he comes straight at us; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the first grey light before sunrise over a wide, slow river at an old ferry crossing; thin mist lies on the water. Coming straight at us, skimming just above the surface, flies the night-winged messenger boy: a thin, light-boned demon-kin youth of seventeen with ragged deep teal-black hair blown back, blue-green eyes looking straight ahead, thin pointed ears, an old leather vest with two slits in the back over a slate shirt whose sleeves are a little short, a flat leather pouch strapped across his chest, a copper button hanging on a cord at his waist, bare feet tucked up. A pair of hard-feathered deep teal wings spreads wide from his back, wider than he is tall, and both wingtips are dragging through the water, cutting two long silver trails across the river behind him. Tied around the tip of one wing flutters a single thin black silk thread, wet with river water. In both arms he holds a small demon-kin boy of nine, seen from behind, wrapped in a grey blanket, two small stubby horns on his head, his arms locked around the youth's neck and his face hidden against his shoulder, unhurt; the youth's jaw is set with the effort of the weight. Behind them, on the far bank, a thick bed of tall reeds hides a cart with a cloth-covered cage whose ropes hang cut and whose door stands open, a lamp still burning on the cart. Further along that bank, two small figures of guards are running away from it after a slim fox-eared runner with a big bushy tail, far off in the mist, who is drawing them away. Flying spray and mist drift out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕第四天天亮以前，赛勒斐恩从收血人的车上把杰姆抱出来，贴着河面飞到东岸（源稿第1665行），翼尖那一根黑丝是莉西娅临走系的（第1950行）。赛勒斐恩十七，杰姆九岁，都没受伤。远处引开看车的是伊坦，太小，没进 who。没画巴尔缇娜中毒流血那几天。

nodes.name: 日落以前
who: the grey-haired girl at the head of the table
the little tide-girl with a notebook
the silver-haired daughter in red gloves
nodes.light: the low copper-gold of the last sun breaking under grey clouds through tall windows on the right, lying in long bars across the table, against the cool dusk-grey of the hall's far corners
nodes.camera: low at the door end of the long table, just behind a child's stool, looking down the full length of the table to the far end; a slight tilt
nodes.text: Scene: just before sunset on an early-winter day in a long, low rope-maker's hall in a grey walled city. The grey clouds outside have broken at the bottom, and the last low sun shines in through the tall windows along the right wall, laying long bars of copper-gold light across one very long table made of pale oak and dark pine planks. Both benches are crowded with delegates, humans on the left and demon-kin on the right, and all of them have turned toward the far end. We are low at the door end of the table, where children's stools stand. In the near foreground, in full profile facing right, sits the little tide-girl with a notebook: a thin girl of ten with long deep sea-blue hair that is always wet, tiny silver fins at her temples in place of ears, a fine sheen of scales on her cheek and neck, a sea-grey wool dress and a small blue shawl; she holds a little corded notebook open on her knees with her left hand and a stub of pencil in her right fist. Halfway down the right bench, the silver-haired daughter in red gloves sits beside her father in full profile, a long deep red dress buttoned high, her gloved hands folded on the table, her face calm. At the far end of the table, facing us, stands the grey-haired girl at the head of the table: small and slight, looking sixteen or seventeen, ash-silver braid pinned in a coil, a small red mark at one temple, a long dark grey high-collared dress and a short black jacket with grey piping; with both hands she is just closing a leather-bound notebook, and her face is earnest and quietly glad. Behind her through a small window the pale glow of a long white wall rises beyond the roofs. Dust motes float in the bars of sunlight out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第十天日落以前日子定下来，巴尔缇娜把它写进本子、合上（源稿第1681行）。用了 s3b_sirentia，任务单把那几个孩子列成没有立绘，立绘目录里有她660年十岁那一版。

nodes.name: 看火
nodes.light: warm orange firelight in the gate passage before them and the soft red and white glow of rows of lamps in the street beyond, against the grey-blue of rain falling in the dark
nodes.camera: low, directly behind the two seated figures, looking past their shoulders and the fire through the inner arch to the lamp-hung street; a slight tilt
nodes.text: Scene: an early-winter night in the south gate passage of a grey walled city at the foot of a long white wall; a fine grey rain is falling outside. A wood fire burns against the stone wall of the passage, and along the base of the wall stands a row of small woven baskets with their oilcloth covers folded back, all of them empty. In the near foreground, seen directly from behind, two women sit side by side on a low stone bench facing the fire, close enough to touch shoulders, and say nothing. On the left is the grey-haired girl: small and slight, ash-silver hair in one long braid over her shoulder, a plain undyed wool dress with long sleeves and a knitted grey shawl, her leather-bound notebook shut on her knee under both hands. On the right sits a tall woman, seen only from behind: short-cropped hair brown with grey in it, a long washed-pale old army greatcoat with no badge of any kind, mended boots, her hands empty and resting on her knees; there is no light about her other than the fire's. Beyond the fire, through the inner arch of the passage, a long street of craftsmen's houses runs away into the city, hung from end to end with lamps, one red and one white, one red and one white, glowing soft through the falling rain, and children with baskets of bread on their arms run between the doors. Raindrops and drifting sparks from the fire glint out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束散桌那一夜雨城点灯，红一盏白一盏，巴尔缇娜走到门洞坐到那个高个子女人旁边，两个人看着火（源稿第1684、1685行）。那个女人只写背影，没写神光。篮子都空着，接三幕幕终天黑以前都领走了。

nodes.name: 蜡印
who: the elf archer with an antler on her bow
nodes.light: the cold blue of a late-autumn mountain dusk from above and behind, warm torchlight from the servants' gate on the right, and a dull red glow from the great fire on the ridge top
nodes.camera: low, just beside the wax basin at the archer's waist height, looking across the basin and up at her, the blood-collector in profile at the right edge; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the evening of a late-autumn feast day high on a black mountain ridge above an old mining belt; the sky is cold blue going dark, and on the ridge top a great fire burns red. We are at the servants' gate cut into the rock. In the near foreground, large and cut off by the bottom of the frame, stands a wide stone basin of warm pale-yellow wax on an iron stand, thin steam rising from it. Leaning over it from the far side, facing us, is the elf archer with an antler on her bow: tall and slender, long pointed ears, long silver-cyan hair tied at the back of her head, pale violet eyes lowered to the wax, her face calm. Her right hand presses its thumb down into the soft wax; her left hand holds her longbow upright at her side, a pale deer antler bound to its upper tip. Over her own clothes she wears a plain grey serving tabard that reaches her ankles, and a single playing card is pinned at its shoulder. On the right, in full profile facing left toward her, stands the blood-collector with clean hands: short and wide-shouldered, dark hair combed flat, a pale square face, pale brown eyes, short pointed ears, a thin curved bleeding-knife at his belt. His left hand holds open a glossy black lacquer box with five thumb-marked wax cakes already set in it; his right hand, scrupulously clean, is held out palm up to take the sixth. Behind the archer, facing us in a short queue, the other five in the same grey tabards, each with a card at the shoulder: a horned tiefling man with a waist-long madder-red braid threaded with bright many-coloured thread, a flax-blond swordsman whose crossguard is wrapped in cloth with white light leaking through the folds, a copper-braided dwarf woman holding a small glowing forge-lamp, a small halfling woman with chestnut curls squaring a deck of cards, and a very tall grey-green half-orc man with a branded number on his collarbone and a smashed iron ring on one ankle. Two guards with spears stand at the torchlit gate. Far above, a lit gateway in the rock and the red fire on the ridge. Steam from the wax and flecks of ash drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕第五拍，中旬八日傍晚仆役门按蜡印。六个人画成本相外罩仆役的灰长衫，肩上各别一张牌，没画成牌变出来的仆役样子。幕终莉西娅端酒那一拍更静，可蜡印是这一条后来一路追下去的起头，挑了它。

nodes.name: 裂面
who: the flax-blond swordsman with white fire on his blade
nodes.light: white-gold light bursting from the crack in the copper face at upper right, against the deep red of hundreds of burning horns and the iron dark of the hall below
nodes.camera: low on the ring-inlaid floor, looking steeply up the slope of the giant hand to the leaping swordsman and the face above; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: deep night inside a great hall carved into a black mountain, a hall as tall as a city gate, its stone floor inlaid with thousands of iron rings forged over a hundred years. In the upper right, enormous and cut off by the frame, looms the god's face above a high seat: a single smooth slab of dull red-bronze mountain copper the size of a house, with no eyes and no mouth. Rising out of a well at the centre of the hall, an immense metal hand bigger than a winch fills the lower left and middle of the picture, its five fingers closing like pincers, its knuckles forming a steep slope. At the top of that slope, the flax-blond swordsman has just leapt from the last knuckle, seen in full profile facing right toward the face: tall and lean, short flax-blond hair, steel-blue eyes, a scar cutting through his eyebrow, his face set and quiet. Both hands grip the hilt; the blade has this instant bitten into the centre of the copper face. A white fire runs the length of the blade, and a pale glowing shell-core is set into the crossguard. The face has split from the temple down to the jaw, and white-gold light pours out of the crack. He has been fighting all night: his long grey-brown wall-mender's coat is torn open at the shoulder, a cut on his cheekbone bleeds a red line down to his jaw, his knuckles are scraped raw, stone dust on him. Below, the floor heaves; iron chains twist up out of it toward the hand. Along the long tables far below, hundreds of seated demon-kin in long dark robes sit very still, their horns all burning a dark red with a thread of gold at the heart, none of them looking up. In the middle of the hall, small, a horned tiefling man with a madder-red braid stands with his mouth open, singing. Sparks, flakes of copper and dark red embers rush large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕第五拍，拿剑的劈裂山铜面，祂入二阶。射箭的钉链、刻字的改环都在这之前，没入画。手从厅心的井里伸出来，脸在高座上，照源稿两处分写，参考图只管祂的样子。

nodes.name: 弦断时
who: the elf archer with an antler on her bow
nodes.light: dark red and gold fire climbing from the antler at the bow's upper tip, against the cold blue-black of a frosty night and a few faint stars
nodes.camera: low on the ridge crest just behind and below her drawing hand, looking past her profile out over the drop and the far pass; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a cold late-autumn night on a high bare ridge at the eastern edge of a mining belt, frost on the rocks, a hard wind, a few faint stars. The largest thing is the sheer rock wall falling away below the ridge, filling the lower left of the picture and cut off by the frame: all along it a row of black iron chains, each as thick as a man's arm, has been pinned flat to the stone by arrows, and they are still shaking. At the foot of the ridge, small and far below, a line of shaggy pack beasts and their riders with torches stands frozen in place, an arrow standing upright in each beast's shadow on the ground. On the right, near the middle of the picture, stands the elf archer, in full profile facing left: tall and slender, long pointed ears, long silver-cyan hair torn loose and streaming back in the wind, pale violet eyes narrowed on something far away, her lips parted on a single word. She wears a long moss-green hooded coat that reaches her ankles, an empty quiver on her back. Her left hand holds the longbow out at arm's length by the grip; her right hand has drawn the string back to her cheek, the last arrow nocked. The deer antler bound to the upper tip of the bow has caught fire: dark red flame with a thread of gold at its heart runs down the upper limb, and near the tip the bowstring glows and is burning through. Far away to the west across the dark, small, a pass opens between two mountains, and in it lies a long low bar of iron glowing dull red, an upright sword planted in it with a faint white fire along its blade. Embers from the antler and grit of frost blow large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第三拍，射箭的上山脊，弓弦烧断时搭着最后一支箭，叫的是山口那个人的名字。远处山口的铁门槛和剑是上一拍拿剑的留下的。幕终唱歌的守着孩子那一拍更静，四幅里已有收束一幅静的，这一幕挑了动的。

nodes.name: 六十三行
who: the grey witch of the rain city
the ox-horned blacksmith with the wagon
nodes.light: the cold blue-grey of an early-winter dusk outside the arch, and warm orange from the risen gate fire filling the passage
nodes.camera: low inside the deep gate passage beside the brazier, looking out through the arch toward the wagon; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dusk in early winter at the south gate of a grey walled city; thin first snow falls mixed with cold drizzle. We are low inside the deep stone gate passage, looking out through the open arch. On the right, large in the near foreground and cut off by the frame, a wood fire burns in a wide iron brazier, its flames risen tall, lighting the whole passage orange; a gatekeeper in a patched grey coat stands beside it with a split log in his hands. In the middle of the passage the grey witch of the rain city crouches on the wet flagstones in full profile facing left toward the arch: small and slender, long ash-silver hair in one braid, cold pale skin, faintly pointed ears, a small red mark at her temple, very light gold eyes, a road-grey cloak over black leather reaching her ankles. Her left hand lightly holds the hand of a small child standing before her; her right hand rests on her knee; she is asking the child's name. The child is a pale long-lived demon-kin girl with faintly pointed ears and no horns, wrapped to the chin in a grey wool blanket, unhurt, her face grave. Just behind the witch, facing us, stands the bone-white keeper of names: tall and lean, pale ash-grey hair tied at the neck, grey-white eyes, bone-white knuckles; an open ledger lies along his left forearm, the crooked little finger of that hand curled over its edge, a small brass bell on that wrist, and his right hand writes a line of small marks with a pen. Outside the arch, facing us, the ox-horned blacksmith, huge, deep bronze-skinned, lifts the next child down from the tailboard of a big wagon with both hands; more children in blankets wait in the wagon and in a line in the snow. On the stone steps just outside the arch, to the left, a long figure lies covered by a faded canvas cloak; from under its edge the end of a long madder-red braid shows, half of it gone white, threaded with many-coloured thread. Snowflakes and sparks from the brazier drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第二拍，灰雨魔女在门洞里接孩子问名字，哈诺写了六十三行。唱歌的照规矩画成盖斗篷躺在石阶上，只露辫梢。守门人朵特没有立绘，补成穿旧灰外套添柴的样子，年纪发色没写。

nodes.name: 竖湖
nodes.light: warm amber torchlight from the banks shining through the standing water on the left, against the deep blue-black of a clear spring night
nodes.camera: low on the dry riverbed beside the girl, almost at sand level, looking up along the fresh furrow toward the towering wall of water; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: past midnight in early spring at the mouth of a new stone channel outside a dry southern valley, under a clear black sky, torches burning along both banks. The left half of the picture is filled by a standing wall of water five men high, rising straight up out of the riverbed and cut off by the top and left edges of the frame: a whole river held upright like a lake set on its edge, and inside it stones, broken tree trunks and churning sand hang suspended, lit amber by the torches through the water. Beside it, on the right bank, the dark mouth of a newly cut stone channel waits empty. At the foot of the water lies a broad slab of blue-grey stone carved with a family crest as worn incised marks. A man of forty-nine bends over it, small beside the water, facing us: cropped iron-grey hair, a hard clean-shaven face, a dark green riding coat buttoned to the throat, his right hand pressed flat on the slab, the heavy seal ring on that hand glowing hot red, his left hand clenched at his side. Behind him a grey horse stands saddled. In the near right foreground, large and partly cut off by the frame, the well-finder's daughter stands in full profile facing left toward the water: nineteen, tall and sturdy, pale wheat-gold hair cut straight at the chin, a faint pale scar across the bridge of her nose, deep green eyes narrowed, a long washed cornflower-blue wool dress to her ankles under an oak-brown jerkin, an old wooden bucket slung on her back. Both her hands hold a short iron pick low, its tip resting in the sand by her boots at the end of one shallow furrow she has just drawn from the foot of the water to the old riverbed on our side. Along that scratch the water is peeling away: thin sheets lift off the base one after another and run down the furrow past her boots in a bright glittering stream into the empty old riverbed, none of it turning toward the channel. A fine crack has just opened across the blue slab under the man's hand. Far behind on the right bank, small, villagers holding empty buckets stand in a row, and grey-coated channel soldiers with crossbows watch beside them. Spray and torch sparks drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕倒数第三拍，半夜渠口五人高的水堤叫梅岱娜一镐划开，水顺划痕回旧河床。恩格尔贝特没有立绘，长相源稿没写，铁灰短发、深绿骑装是补的。画的是青石刚起裂、印戒发烫的那一下，还没松手。

nodes.name: 蜡印
who: the bronze-skinned giantess under the bridge
nodes.light: the hard pale-white glare of fire pouring along the moat floor from the left, against the dusty ochre shade under the bridge and a bleached midsummer sky
nodes.camera: low on the moat floor at the foot of the east bridge pier, close beside the kneeling woman, looking up past her at the underside of the bridge; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: midday in high summer at a walled bridge fort on the southern stretch of the long white wall. We are down in a deep, dry, stone-lined moat. A long stone bridge crosses high above, its underside cutting diagonally across the top of the picture and cut off by the frame; along its rail a line of people carries the last stretchers toward the east side. Along a freshly dug trench in the moat floor, white fire pours toward us from the left like a stream of liquid light, pale flames with blue-white cores, jetting up from cracks between the paving stones. In the near right foreground, large, the well-finder kneels in a narrow cross-channel she has just cut across that trench; the white fire has spilled into her channel behind her and runs low there, half its height. She faces us: twenty-one, tall and sturdy, pale wheat-gold hair cut straight at the chin, a faint scar across the bridge of her nose, deep green eyes, a long dark blue wool coat to her shins with the sleeves pushed to the elbow, an old wooden bucket on her back. With both hands she is lifting an unbroken squat clay jar out of the earth, its mouth sealed with yellow wax pressed with a small stamped seal of incised lines. Her face is wet with sweat and streaked with soot, the backs of both hands red and blistered from the heat; a short pick lies by her knee. In the middle distance on the left, under the middle of the sagging span, a giantess stands in the white fire, facing us: very tall and heavily built, deep bronze skin, red-tinged black hair in tight flat braids, short dark red horns sweeping back, a long dull red wool coat to her ankles smouldering at the hem. Both arms are raised above her head, both palms pressed flat against the underside of the bridge, holding it up; smoke rises from her palms, and her amber eyes are calm. On the fort wall at the upper right, crossbowmen lean over the battlements with drawn bows aimed down. Far off at the west end of the bridge, tiny, a slender girl with long silver-grey hair stands with her mouth open. Beyond her, on a distant slope, a small horned figure with fire on his horns holds one hand raised. Embers and white sparks rush large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕第六拍，第1203行起，梅岱娜在火沟上横凿空槽、把东桥脚底下第三只罐子整个刨出来。托桥的是芭鲁娜，画在中景，事归她，梅岱娜只做挖罐子。桥西传话的莉赛尔此年十九岁、穆塔兹都只画成远处小人。

nodes.name: 旧枪
who: the spearwoman of the lower weir
nodes.light: the thin pale gold of first light coming over the long wall far ahead, against the cold blue-grey shadow between the rock walls
nodes.camera: low in the mud at the outer mouth of the stone neck, just past the spear's reach, looking up at the old woman and up the channel behind her; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dawn in early autumn at the narrowest point of a dry old riverbed, where two grey rock walls pinch close together; behind us the channel opens into the reed marshes outside the long wall. Mist and dew hang in the cold air. Against both rock walls, piled higher than a cottage roof, lie heaps of shed bone carapace: the grey-white plated back shells of great burrowing fish-beasts, ridged and heavy, one huge shell near the middle split cleanly in two from end to end. The mud between them is churned and wet, and a thin bright thread of water runs along an old water mark at the foot of the left wall. In the near foreground the spearwoman stands facing us, still thrusting: forty-eight, solid in the shoulders, long deep red hair streaked with early white, tied at the nape and half come loose, bright honey-coloured eyes wide and fixed on nothing. Her left hand is forward on the shaft of a plain old ash spear with a notched iron head, her right hand drawn back at her ribs on the butt, the point driving toward the lower left of the frame past us. Three nights have marked her: dried and fresh blood from cuts on her brow and cheek, one sleeve of her long brown wool coat torn open at the forearm and dark with blood, mud to the knees. At her right side a girl of fourteen stands in full profile facing her, unhurt and clean: a thin girl with an auburn braid, a long grey wool dress to her ankles under an apron, a water skin slung at her hip. Both the girl's hands grip the woman's right elbow, and her mouth is open, calling out. Behind them, up the channel, a tall woman with chin-length wheat-gold hair sits on a boulder with a pick across her knees. Far beyond, the white long wall closes the channel; an old cast-iron sluice gate stands half-lowered between stone piers, a sluice house beside it with a small figure with ink-blue hair at its window, and on the platform above the gate there is no one. Dew mist and drifting reed fluff blur large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕幕终，天亮，朵娜还在往前刺，列芙娅攥着她的手肘喊外婆，闸台上灰马不见了。列芙娅十四岁，无立绘，长相是补的，画成没伤没血。沟鳍只画成褪下的骨甲堆，不画尸身。

nodes.name: 青石两半
nodes.light: low clear winter sun from the right, pale gold on the stone and the water, against the heavy blue-grey of clouds massed over the far mountain
nodes.camera: low beside the slab at the edge of the thin stream, looking up at the woman at the bottom of her swing; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a clear cold day in early winter, outside a dry southern valley, at the place where a river once turned into a stone channel. The near middle of the picture is a broad slab of blue-grey stone lying at the edge of the old riverbed, its face carved with a family crest as worn incised marks, an old crack already running across it. The well-finder has just brought her pick down into that crack. She stands in full profile on the left of the slab, facing right, at the very bottom of the swing: thirty-one, tall and sturdy, pale wheat-gold hair cut straight at the chin, a faint scar across the bridge of her nose, deep green eyes on the stone, a long washed cornflower-blue wool dress to her ankles under a sheepskin-lined jerkin, an old wooden bucket on her back with its rope tied in a neat slip knot. Both hands grip the haft low, the iron head sunk into the crack, and the slab is coming apart into two halves, stone chips and grey dust bursting up from the split. Beside the slab, in the old riverbed, the river runs only ankle-deep, a thin clear thread over pale stones. On the far bank the mouth of the cut stone channel stands dry, weeds at its lip. On the right, a few village children in wool cloaks and knitted caps stand at the water's edge holding small wooden buckets, watching. Far behind, beyond a bare ridge, a great mountain rises with heavy grey rain clouds massed around its top, while the sky over the valley is clean and empty. Stone chips and winter dust drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束倒数第二拍，636年梅岱娜回谷外一镐凿开青石。一幕源稿已写青石裂成两半，收束又写凿成两半，这里画成旧裂缝上一镐分开，要主会话定。季节取636年冬。

nodes.name: 第四粒
who: the mild old priest with the nine-stone staff
nodes.light: the cold blue-grey of early morning from the river beyond the bridge, against a flood of blinding white light pouring down from the top of the arch
nodes.camera: from just inside the city at waist height, looking out through the gate passage toward the bridge, the arch filling the frame and cut off at the top; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dawn of an early spring day at the fourth gate of the upper city of a great river city, the gate that faces the bridge. We stand just inside the city and look out through the gate passage toward the bridge. A tall arch of pale white stone, so white it is faintly blue-green, rises over the whole picture, its top cut off by the upper frame. Under it a long wooden table blocks half the passage, and two rows of grey-robed attendants stand facing each other along the road. At the left, behind the table, in full profile facing right, stands the mild old priest with the nine-stone staff: middle height, a slightly stooped back, thin short white hair, bushy white eyebrows, pale blue eyes, a long plain white-and-grey robe from neck to ankle. His right hand holds an ash-wood prayer staff whose butt has just come down on the paving; on its head nine small white stones are set in an arch, and the fourth of them burns bright. His left hand rests flat on the table. He is smiling gently. From the top of the arch a flood of white light pours straight down like water tipped from a bucket. In the middle of the passage, hanging in the air in one flat sheet, fifty-two playing cards are catching fire all at once, curling and breaking into flakes of grey ash. Just beyond the arch, on the right, facing us, stands the halfling card-girl: very small, honey-gold curls in two bunches each pinned with a little butterfly folded from a playing card, freckles across her nose, huge teal-green eyes looking up at the burning cards, her mouth pressed tight. Her right hand is still raised, fingers spread, where she held the cards up; her left hand rests on a tall wooden card trunk standing on end beside her, taller than she is. Behind her about forty people from the lower town wait on the bridge in a long line, porters, laundresses, mothers holding children by the hand, all fully dressed and unhurt, all staring. In the near right foreground, partly cut off by the frame, a tall lean young man with a smooth young face, deep red hair combed straight back and a deep blue scholar's robe stands in full profile facing left, a stick of charcoal in his right hand and a sheet of thin paper pinned to a board in his left, not looking up from it. Flakes of card ash and dust in the morning light drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕第五拍（源稿“帘子撑到第四十一个人”那一条），迪波尔德杖头第四粒白石亮、五十二张牌烧成灰。尤利乌斯在这一年二十五岁，任务单的 s3a_julius 是四十一岁的长相（两鬓已白），没进 who，在 text 里照年轻的样子写，请主会话定要不要用他的立绘。

nodes.name: 门外灯
nodes.light: the faint cold blue-white glow of the arch stone itself on the left, against one small warm yellow lantern flame lighting the faces from below
nodes.camera: low, from the foot of the arch just outside it, at the height of the crouching people, looking along the wall; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: late night in early spring in the upper city of a great river city, outside one of its nine gates. A tall arch of pale white stone fills the left side of the picture and is cut off by the frame at the top and the left edge; the stone gives off a faint cold glow of its own, white with a blue-green tinge, and the passage under it is dark and empty. Beyond it a narrow cobbled street climbs between shuttered stone houses. Along the foot of the wall outside the arch, on the right, a handful of people crouch on the cobbles in a row, facing us, wrapped from neck to ankle in plain long coats and cloaks against the cold: a young woman with small stub horns half hidden in her hood, a beast-eared man whose ears are bare where a bell used to be tied, a broad porter whose coat collar shows the edge of an old brand at the shoulder, an old man hugging a bundle. In the middle of the picture, in full profile facing right toward them, stands the lantern-bearer: a slight figure of no clear age in a long hooded grey-brown cloak, the hood shading the face so that only the chin shows. The right hand holds up a small tin lantern with a warm yellow flame; the left hand is held out low, palm down and flat, the gesture of telling people to go slowly. The lantern-bearer is speaking one quiet sentence. The crouching people look up at the lantern, their faces lit warm from below, perfectly still. Far behind, small, past the rooftops, the next of the nine arches glows faintly white, and beyond it another, a chain of pale arches across the dark city; on a distant roof ridge a tiny figure sits beside a tall trunk. Cold night mist and a few drifting early blossoms float large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕幕终（八日夜里提灯的一道门一道门传话）。提灯的、门外蹲着的人源稿没有写长相，照身份补的。拱门是天黑以前才亮的，夜里写成白石自己的淡光，远处屋脊上的小人是裴珀，只是一个剪影。

nodes.name: 末行
who: the mild old priest with the nine-stone staff
nodes.light: blinding white light pouring down from the whole arch, cut across by the dark red fire with a gold core running along a blade and along the carved marks, thousands of warm lamps in the plaza behind
nodes.camera: from the paving just under the arch, wide-angle, looking steeply up at the keystone and the leaping figure; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the night of the spring feast in the great plaza of the upper city, thousands of lamps burning on poles and on long tables. We look steeply up from the paving just under the ninth gate.
