The arch of pale blue-white stone rises overhead and is cut off by the top of the frame; its keystone is right above us, and along the underside of the keystone runs a band of old carved marks, the last line of them shallower and rougher than the rest. At this instant white light is pouring down from the whole arch, blinding, flooding over the paving ankle-deep, and paper doves caught in it are bursting into small flames. In the lower left, at the foot of the arch, the old priest stands facing us, bent forward: thin white hair blown back, bushy white brows drawn hard together, pale blue eyes fixed up at the keystone, his long white-and-grey robe flaring in the light. Both his hands grip his ash-wood staff and drive its head, set with nine small white stones, down into a stone socket at the foot of the arch; the nine stones glare. On the right, a lean figure in a long dark coat and a worn leather apron has leapt from the wooden pyre platform beside the arch and is in mid-air, seen in full profile facing left, short dark hair, the face set: both hands on the hilt of a long blade, swinging it into the shallow last line of marks. The blade burns with a dark red fire that gives no smoke, a single thread of gold at its core, and where it bites, that fire runs along the shallow marks and a crack is opening from them through the white stone, speed lines bursting out from the strike. At the far right edge a young grey-robed stone-keeper stands empty-handed, a white stone lying on the paving at his feet. Far behind, small, the packed crowd of the plaza, a lamp-lit stage with an open card trunk on it, and across the city other pale arches blazing white with a dark red fire climbing their pillars. Burning paper doves, sparks and white dust rush large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第七拍（源稿“迪波尔德自己走到拱心底下……磨刀的跃上柴台，一刀砍在拱心石末尾那行浅字上”）。磨刀的源稿没有长相，补的。右边执石是凯斯帕，二十岁，源稿没写长相，只写他空着手、白石放在地上。没有人受伤，raw 不写。

nodes.name: 三息
who: the mild old priest with the broken staff
nodes.light: the pale gold of a spring dawn behind the priest from the plaza, against the soft cool blue-white glow of the relit arch above
nodes.camera: from inside the gate passage at chest height, looking out at the priest standing at the threshold, the arch's inner edge framing the top; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: early dawn in spring of the following year, at the ninth gate on the edge of a wide plaza in the upper city of a great river city. We stand inside the gate passage and look out. The pale blue-white arch frames the top and the right side of the picture and is cut off by the frame; it glows softly again, and straight down through its keystone runs one clean dark crack, the stone around it whole. Just outside, at the threshold, facing us, stands the old priest: thin short white hair, bushy white eyebrows, pale blue eyes, a long white-and-grey robe from neck to ankle, its hem dark with dew, his back a little more stooped than before. He has stopped one step short of the arch. His right hand holds an ash-wood prayer staff broken off at half its length, the head gone, the break worn smooth; his left hand hangs at his side, fingers half closed. His face is mild and tired, his eyes lifted to the crack above us, his mouth closed. A little behind him stand eight young new stone-keepers in plain grey robes, in a loose line, each with a small white stone hung at the collar, waiting and watching him. Behind them the plaza is swept bare; where a stage and a pyre once stood there is only a paler square on the paving, and the lamp poles stand unlit. Far away above the rooftops other pale arches glow faintly in a chain, and the first light lies gold along the wet stones. Morning dust and a few fallen spring blossoms drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第三条（599年萌芽月重念一夜，他走第九道门以前在拱前停了三息）。他这时拿的杖源稿没写，照三幕末侍女捡起来放回他手里的那半截写，请主会话看要不要改成一柄新杖。

赫伯特·韦尔夫特.how: 他坐在坞口那间小屋里，没有再起来，七十七岁。坞簿交给了巴斯蒂安，往后坞口是巴斯蒂安守着。

刻字的.when: 山铜纪649年霜降月中旬八日夜里
刻字的.how: 她说炉得有人看火，没有跟着走。她把炉灯里的王炉火按进自己胸口，烧成了一根立在厅心的火柱，四壁的字从此亮着，山腹里的链子一直是软的。

扛链子的.when: 山铜纪649年霜降月中旬九日天亮前
扛链子的.how: 葛摩恩在地底拽塌了坑口的山，他两手撑住落下来的石头，孩子从他腋下一个一个跑过去。数到最后一个，他没有松手，暗红的火从锁骨上的号里烧出来，把压在肩上的山石熔成了一道拱。

拿剑的.how: 他叫车先走，一个人站在两山中间。铁脊像潮头一样立起来，他把剑插进地里，白火和暗红的火拧成一根，追到山口的那股锁链熔成了一道铁门槛，剑还立在上头。

射箭的.how: 她上了山脊，三天里追兵的驮兽一头一头叫箭钉住了影子。弓弦烧断的时候她正搭着最后一支箭，叫的是山口那个人的名字。火从弓梢的鹿角烧起来，整道山脊亮了一夜。

变戏法的.how: 她摸了摸唱歌的辫子，转过身已经是他的样子，连嗓子也是。祖拉克按下最后两块蜡，两股铁脊一齐朝她去，她往北走进荒原，走到望不见车的地方才回头鞠了一躬。火柱烧起来的时候，原上到处飘着纸牌大的灰蛾子。

唱歌的.when: 山铜纪649年初雪月中旬九日
唱歌的.how: 断岭西脚他把三句誓又唱了一遍，誓线烧断了，他的辫子白了一半。往后他一夜接一夜地唱，孩子围着他指尖的火睡。车到南门那天黄昏，他走在头里，倒在门洞前的石阶上，嘴里的誓还剩半句，火全进了门洞的火里。

塞巴德.how: 归寂月最后一夜石饲之乡抽了签，他跟中签的人家一起进山，说“我去要水。”萌芽月中旬一日天亮前，封石在他身后合上。女儿在山口每天听见一响，第七天傍晚是最后一响，他放出来的水涨回了谷外的旧河床，他没有出来。

裴珀·叠牌.label: 下落不明
裴珀·叠牌.how: 净门礼那一夜她打开执石房，放出了关着的十二个人。十日天亮，她的牌箱留在礼台上，箱盖内侧多了一只灰烬的蛾子，人不见了。
